verdict.rationale: Appwrite's Auth docs claim a first-party presence capability: tracking which signed-in users are active and broadcasting online, typing, and viewing status in realtime. That covers both presence tracking and ephemeral client-to-client state, on top of the documented realtime event layer. missing for 10: in-depth docs on the presence API and its ephemeral-state semantics (channels, TTL/expiry, custom payloads), and independent or hands-on corroboration that it works as described.

support.subject: As a developer, I can track user presence and broadcast ephemeral state between connected clients

citations.quote: Track which signed-in users are active right now and broadcast online, typing, and viewing status in realtime.
Respond to server events in realtime.
